article.title: Security forces kill 15 terrorists trying to cross into Pakistan through Afghan border: ISPR
article.summary: Security forces have killed 15 terrorists who were trying to infiltrate into Pakistan through its border with Afghanistan, the military’s media affairs wing said on Thursday.According to a statement issued by the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), the terrorists had tried to cross into Pakistan’s North Waziristan district on the night between August 31 and September 1.Their movement, however, was detected by security forces, the statement said, adding that the troops “responded professionally and with patience to engage them”.“As a result of precise and skillful engagement that lasted for 36 hours, 15khawarijbelonging to India-sponsoredFitna-al-Khawarij” were killed, the statement added.The state uses the termFitna al Khawarijfor the banned Tehreek-i-Taliban Pakistan (TTP).ISPR said that during the sanitisation operation after the engagement, large quantities of weapons and ammunition were recovered from the slain terrorists. article.title: Security forces kill 12 terrorists in Kalat IBO: ISPR
article.summary: Security forces have killed 12 terrorists in an intelligence-based operation in Kalat district of Balochistan, the military’s media wing said on Friday.According to the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR), the operation was conducted on September 2 following reports about the presence of terrorists belonging to what it described as the Indian proxy “Fitna al Hindustan”.During the operation, the forces identified and monitored a terrorist hideout before busting it through a “prompt and surgical” action, the ISPR said.“All 12 Indian-sponsored terrorists” were killed, while a cache of ammunition and improvised explosive devices was destroyed at the site, it added.Sanitisation operations were under way to eliminate any other terrorists found in the area, the military’s media wing said.The ISPR said the counterterrorism campaign under the vision of “Azm-e-Istehkam”, approved by the Federal Apex Committee on the National Action Plan, would continue at full pace.The campaign, it added, ...

article.title: Security forces kill 48 terrorists in separate Balochistan operations: ISPR
article.summary: Security forces killed 48 terrorists in multiple intelligence-based operations across Balochistan during the last 48 hours, the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR) said on Friday.According to the military’s media wing, the operations were conducted in Mastung, Quetta, Kalat and Sibi districts against what it described as Indian-sponsored militants affiliated with Fitna al Hindustan and Fitna al Khwarij.In Mastung, security forces identified and engaged a group of terrorists on September 4. An intense exchange of fire resulted in the killing of six terrorists, while a cache of ammunition and improvised explosive devices (IEDs) was also destroyed at the site, ISPR said.In another intelligence-based operation in the Shaban area of Quetta district, security forces identified four militant hideouts.
